subject: POC onboarding: environment checklist & MAP sprint commitments
messages:
From: Jane Doe <jane.doe@beaconbio.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-04T09:12:00Z
Subject: POC kickoff & MAP — environment needs

Vivek,

Thanks for the intro call this morning. Beacon Bio is ready to move forward with a short POC to validate inference latency and cost for our internal clinical search workflow. To confirm our must-haves for the MAP and environment: API keys + org-level access, IP allowlist for our load balancers, and an option for VPC peering to our staging VPC (we can also accept a controlled hosted endpoint if peering is slow).

Requested timeline: we’d like the environment live within 7–10 business days to hit an internal demo the week of Jun 22. Key questions:
- What info do you need from our infra team for peering (CIDR ranges, project IDs)?
- Can you provide a short MAP with milestones we can commit to?
- How do you handle API key rotation and KMS integration?

Looping Emily (our CTO) for infra details.

Thanks,
Jane
Jane Doe
Head of Platforms, Beacon Bio

On Wed, Jun 2, 2026 at 15:10 Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Looking forward to partnering — will follow up with a proposed MAP and sprint breakdown.

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Jane Doe <jane.doe@beaconbio.com>, Emily Chen <emily.chen@beaconbio.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-04T14:03:00Z
Subject: Re: POC kickoff & MAP — environment needs

Jane / Emily — thanks. Draft MAP and next steps below (attached as redwood-map-v1.xlsx). High level plan and commitments: 

1) Discovery (Day 0–1): collect CIDR ranges, SRE contact, preferred peering window, and expected peak qps.
2) Org & Keys (Day 1–2): create a Beacon org in the console, generate scoped API keys for the POC, share initial keys via secure link. Keys will be time-limited for the PoC; we’ll provide rotation instructions.
3) IP allowlist (Day 2–3): add your LB public IPs to hosted endpoints; verify reachability.
4) VPC peering (optional, Day 3–7): if you choose peering, we'll coordinate peering setup and route validation — need CIDR, project / account id, and peering contact.
5) Validation & smoke tests (Day 4–8): run sample workload, measure tail P99s, and run cost estimate.

I’ve attached the MAP spreadsheet with milestone owners and dates. Proposed owners from our side: Aditya (network/API orchestration), Mina (security & SOC2 evidence). From Beacon: your SRE + App owner.

A couple of notes on your questions:
- API key rotation: we support short-lived keys + manual rotation. For HV workflows we can integrate customer KMS for secrets at the Private deployment layer — we’ll scope this if you move to Private.
- KMS: for Hosted PoC we recommend using our managed keystore; if you require BYOK, we’ll include it in the MAP and estimate extra setup time.

Next steps: please share CIDR ranges and a primary peering contact. I’ll set up a 30-min kickoff to lock dates and cut over the MAP to shared Drive.

Best,
Vivek
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-map-v1.xlsx (MAP draft)
HubSpot: https://hubspot.example/deal/BEO-2026-052

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-05T10:25:00Z
Subject: Re: POC onboarding: environment checklist & MAP sprint commitments

Looping in a quick internal checklist so we don’t miss anything when Beacon replies:
- Prepare hosted endpoint with per-tenant scoped API keys (TTL 14 days) — ACTION: Aditya
- Generate secure Share link for initial keys (1-time use) — ACTION: Aditya
- Pull latest SOC2 artifact snapshot for Beacon — ACTION: Mina (attach soc2-snapshot)
- Pre-create peering template & config docs for public cloud providers — ACTION: Aditya

I’ll draft the internal runbook for the peering handoff. If Beacon wants BYOK we’ll need to schedule an extra 2–3 business days for KMS handoff.

-Aditya
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood

From: Emily Chen <emily.chen@beaconbio.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jane Doe <jane.doe@beaconbio.com>
Date: 2026-06-06T08:47:00Z
Subject: Re: POC kickoff & MAP — environment needs

Vivek — thanks for the clear plan. Beacon SRE answers below:
- CIDR (staging): 10.240.0.0/16
- Account ID / Project: gcp-project-beacon-stg-42
- Peering contact: Sam Li <sam.li@beaconbio.com> (SRE)
- Expected peak for POC: 150 qps sustained, bursts to 400 qps

We prefer VPC peering for the demo; please propose two peering windows next week (prefer mornings PST). Also confirm whether hosted API IP allowlist + peering can coexist (we want both for fallback).

Also: would appreciate a quick note on how you’ll handle API key rotation during the POC — we can run a rotation test during validation.

Thanks,
Emily
CTO, Beacon Bio

On Thu, Jun 4, 2026 at 14:03 Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Draft MAP attached — will follow up with timeline options.

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Chen <emily.chen@beaconbio.com>, Jane Doe <jane.doe@beaconbio.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-09T15:27:00Z
Subject: Re: POC onboarding: environment checklist & MAP sprint commitments

Thanks, Emily — that info is perfect. Quick confirmations and next steps: 

- Coexistence: yes — we’ll configure hosted endpoints with an allowlist and keep peering as the primary route; fallback will use hosted endpoint if peering experiences route issues (we’ll document the automatic fallback in the MAP).
- Proposed peering windows (mornings PST): Jun 15 09:00–11:00 PST or Jun 17 09:00–11:00 PST — please confirm which works for Sam.
- API key rotation during POC: we’ll issue initial keys with 14-day TTL and provide a rotation script (Python) that calls our admin API to rotate keys. We’ll run one rotation during validation and confirm the app handles 401s gracefully.

Attached: SOW for signature (sow-beacon-docusign.pdf). Once the SOW is countersigned I’ll: (1) provision the org and keys, (2) add your IPs to the allowlist, and (3) schedule the peering window with Aditya owning the peering ops. Mina will start the SOC2 snapshot handoff.

Next action: Jane / Sam to confirm peering window + SRE/ops Slack channel to use for the cutover. I’ll move the MAP to the shared Drive and update milestone owners.

Best,
Vivek
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference

Attachments: sow-beacon-docusign.pdf; soc2-snapshot-2026-04.pdf; redwood-map-v1.xlsx
Doc links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0B_example_map_materials, HubSpot: https://hubspot.example/deal/BEO-2026-052
